snippet.title: Digging Together - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Digging Together on Steam

Digging Together is a digging game that blends friendship and competition, allowing you to go underground with up to four friends to search for treasure.
In co-op mode, work together to collect minerals and upgrade your character with modules. But be careful… In Treasure Hunt mode, everyone is out for themselves! Push your rivals aside, block their paths with dynamite, and be the first to reach the treasure. With its stylized visuals, playful language, and dynamic gameplay, Digging Together shows just how chaotic playing together can be.
